━━━━━━━━━━
1️⃣ TUE 27 OCT, 18:30 — CAROUSEL
Files in this order: 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 ↓

Masak daging BBQ tanpa minyak? Bisa, cuma 3 langkah 🔥

1️⃣ Cairkan dulu — dari freezer, taruh di kulkas semalam
2️⃣ Panaskan teflon, tanpa minyak — bumbunya sudah lengkap
3️⃣ Panggang sampai empuk — balik sekali-dua kali, selesai!

Simpan post ini biar gak lupa 📌
Tips lengkapnya ada di website: jentiskitchen.id (link di bio)

🎁 Pembelian pertama diskon 35%, langsung di checkout (maks. Rp100.000, khusus produk).

#jentiskitchen #carmasak #masaktanpaminyak #dagingmarinasi #bbqdirumah #resepmudah #menumakanmalam #kulinerjakarta #masakdirumah

How to post:
1. Instagram → + → Post → "Select multiple" → slides 1–5 IN ORDER.
2. Crop icon → keep the full 4:5 size.
3. Paste the caption → location: Jakarta → Share.
4. How-to posts get SAVED a lot — reply to comments asking about cooking with a short tip.

Files: video + cover ↓

3 langkah, tanpa minyak, tanpa ribet 🔥 Cairkan → teflon panas → panggang sampai empuk.
Pembelian pertama diskon 35% langsung di checkout — link di bio 👆
*Maks. Rp100.000, khusus produk.

How to post the Reel:
1. + → Reel → pick the video.
2. 🎵 Audio → a calm/cooking trending song (search "cooking").
3. Edit cover → Add from camera roll → the cover image.
4. Paste the caption → Share. Keep "Also share to Feed" ON.
5. Then: paper-plane → Add to story.

File ↓
